brand_identity.name: Chillax
brand_identity.mission: To make travel planning as relaxing as the vacation itself.

headings.usage: Use for all section headers, hero titles, and card titles. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraph text, inputs, and UI labels. Normal tracking.

primary.name: Coral Sunset
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, brand highlights.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B6B] hover:bg-[#FF5252] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-orange-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-[#E5E7EB] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:border-[#FF6B6B] hover:text-[#FF6B6B] rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-[#6B7280] hover:text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
cards.padding: p-0 for image sections, p-5 for content

inputs.style: bg-gray-50 border-transparent focus:border-[#FF6B6B] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF6B6B]/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-lg transition-all

visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All clickable elements must have hover:scale or hover:brightness effects.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and bento grids.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Ensure all images have alt text for accessibility.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the 'Chillax' travel app. Follow these guidelines strictly. Use the provided image URLs for their respective sections. Implement the 'Coral Sunset' primary color for main actions. Use Shadcn UI components but customize them with the 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-gray-100' styles to match the brand. Create a 'Layout' component that wraps pages with the standard navbar and footer.
